name: list_projects
description: List the Komla projects you may start workspaces in, by id and name.

name: list_workspaces
description: List the Komla workspaces in your projects: each one's id, name, project, branch, whether its agent is working, and the attention it shows, such as input-required when its agent waits for the user.

includeTrashed.description: Also list workspaces in the Trash.

name: launch_workspace
description: Start an AI coding agent in a new Komla workspace: its own branch and working directory, branched from the project's base branch, with your prompt as its first message. The user sees it in Komla and can steer it there.

project.description: The project, by an id or name list_projects gives.

name.description: A 2-3 word title for the workspace.

branch.description: A branch name, such as "fix-login-redirect". Komla names one otherwise. When the SSH host already has the name, a number goes on its end: workspace_status gives the branch the workspace got.

agent.description: The agent to start, by name, such as Claude Code. Without it, the user's pick.

mode.description: One of that agent's launch modes, by name. Only modes the user lets agents start work.

name: workspace_status
description: One workspace's state, as list_workspaces gives it: whether its agent is working, and the attention it shows, such as turn-complete once its agent finished.

workspaceId.description: The id launch_workspace or list_workspaces gave.
